answer: Before an agent can vote, it locks a 25-POA bond to a quartz identity that only unlocks after three graded epochs. Each missed pulse burns 4 POA and publishes a plume of the slash so peers refuse to reuse that bond. A farm of 120 aliases must lock 3000 POA up front and keep every identity answering, or lose 480 POA per missed round—more than the epoch reward—so extra heads raise capital at risk linearly.
